title: IL-Property-ML: honest, IL-disjoint prediction of ionic-liquid properties (companion papers)
description: Five companion manuscripts on honest, IL-disjoint prediction of ionic-liquid (IL) properties. v1.0.0: structure-based framework on 11,511 records / 1,658 ion pairs (MLR/GBM/MLP with RDKit descriptors + Morgan fingerprints, IL-disjoint validation, SHAP). v1.1.0: companion study expanding the database 7.7-fold to 88,077 records / 1,891 unique ion pairs via NIST ILThermo v2.0. v1.2.0: feature-scale companion (458 per-ion RDKit descriptors). v1.3.0: graph-vs-descriptor companion (GNN vs descriptors under IL-disjoint validation). v1.4.0: inverse-design companion (Pareto screening, three-model cross-validation, 11 unreported candidates). v2.0.0: data-scale companion for generative design — experimental set expanded to 6,177 unique ILs (Mendeley tpp25ztzmb merged), 8.33M-IL virtual space (219,292 cations x 38 anions) with two independent predictor families (ILPE ML + ILBERT chemLM), three predictors (GBM/HistGBM/MPNN) retrained under IL-disjoint validation (melting-point R2 +0.10 to +0.20), SMILES language model reaching 99.9% validity/charge correctness, 7 three-predictor-consistent novel candidates from 1.68M-pair screening, and an honest cross-source analysis showing no virtual IL is predicted to beat the known optimum.
